name: Yukimi Kakigori
description: Yukimi Kakigori — a kakigori shaved-ice parlour theme built on sticky media: on wide screens the picture column holds still while the text column scrolls past it (the menu, the four bowl rows, the story band and the parlour page). A formal top header, centred: the parlour name and tagline in the middle of the first row, the menu centred on the second row and the Reserve a seat button at the right end; an overlay menu on phones and tablets. Sora-iro, the clear pale sky blue of traditional Japanese colour names (#A9D3E8), is the main colour: the hero, the story band, every page head and the overlay menu are solid ice-blue fields set in deep blue ink, on an ice-white ground with pale ice-mist panels and deep lake-blue links, cool and fresh like a bowl of shaved ice; the red of the strawberry bowl and the peach of the white-peach bowl are the only warm notes. The hero is a product grid: the title, lead, buttons and today's ice on the left, four paper-cut bowls as a taped, slightly tilted 2 x 2 collage on the right, and a cut-out bowl of strawberry ice (transparent WebP) standing in front of the grid and breaking over the hero bottom edge; a cut-out plover flag breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a layered paper-cut illustration in a torn, taped paper collage. Darumadrop One for display, Rubik for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: v1.0.2 recolour (2026-10-17): the main colour is now sora-iro, a clear pale sky ice blue #A9D3E8, with deep blue ink #12263A, an ice-white ground and ice-mist panels, for the cool, fresh feel of a shaved-ice parlour (the design plan palette family is now blue, and the unbuilt rows b4-10 and b4-12 swapped palettes to keep the window rule); the sample garden is now a snowy pond garden with a white plum tree, and eight pictures were regenerated in the new palette. Otherwise built to design-plan.json row b4-8 (sticky-media, product-grid-hero, centered nav, collage, paper-cut, Darumadrop One + Rubik, food-drink). A formal top header with the parlour name, a centred menu row and the Reserve a seat button. Sticky media on wide screens: the menu intro and ice-block picture, each bowl picture on The menu, the story collage and the parlour picture hold still while the text scrolls. Break-frame: the cut-out bowl breaks over the hero bottom edge and the cut-out plover flag over the story band and page heads.

summary.zh-TW: 空色淡冰藍的刨冰店：拼貼剪紙商品格狀主視覺、去背刨冰破格而出、置中選單、圖文並排的固定圖片欄，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A sora ice-blue kakigori parlour: a paper-cut product grid hero, a cut-out bowl breaking out and sticky picture columns.
summary.ja: 空色の涼しいかき氷店。切り絵の商品グリッド、枠を越える切り抜きの氷、中央のメニュー、止まる画像列。
summary.fr: Un salon de kakigori bleu glacier : grille de bols en papier découpé, bol détouré qui déborde, images fixes au défilement.
summary.de: Ein eisblauer Kakigori-Salon: Scherenschnitt-Raster im Hero, freigestellte Schale bricht aus, stehende Bildspalten.
